item.title: Correlation between gravitational wave frequencies as a signature of new black hole physics
item.description: arXiv:2610.20167v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We point out that for black holes (BH) of the same mass, despite of arising from two entirely different physical arguments, the peak frequency of the coarse-grained gravitational wave (GW) spectrum of gravitons $f_\text{peak}^\text{graviton}$ is very close to the peak frequency of the GW spectrum produced from binary BH mergers $f_\text{peak}^\text{merger}$. item.title: Audible curvaton: modulated phase transition as the origin of large-scale curvature perturbations and gravitational wave anisotropies
item.description: arXiv:2610.18975v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a post-inflationary first-order phase transition modulated by a light spectator field as the origin of primordial large-scale curvature perturbations. item.title: LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA Collaboration successfully wraps up its fourth Observing Run
item.description: Today, the international LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA Collaboration celebrates the successful completion of its fourth observing run (O4), marking another major step forward in the exploration of the gravitational wave universe. item.title: GWTC-5.0: Updated LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA Catalog sets new records in precision gravitational wave astronomy
item.description: The LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA Collaboration released today a new catalog of gravitational wave events.
